Horsehead Corporation is a leading chemical company headquartered in Monaca, Pennsylvania. With a rich history dating back to its founding in 1960, the company has established itself as a trusted provider of high-quality chemicals and raw materials for a wide range of industries. 

Located at 300 Frankfort Road in Monaca, Horsehead Corporation is known for its commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence in all aspects of its operations. The company specializes in the production and distribution of a variety of chemicals, including zinc oxide, zinc dust, and zinc sulfate, among others.

At Horsehead Corporation, we are dedicated to meeting the needs of our customers with top-notch products and exceptional service. Our state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technology allow us to consistently deliver superior quality chemicals that meet the highest industry standards.

In addition to our commitment to quality, Horsehead Corporation is also dedicated to environmental stewardship and sustainability. We take great pride in our efforts to reduce our environmental impact and operate in a responsible and sustainable manner.

As a trusted partner in the chemical industry, Horsehead Corporation is poised for continued growth and success. We look forward to serving our customers and delivering the highest quality products for many years to come.
